title: Treatment reminders not always working
body:
This may not actually be an issue, it could just be me not doing things correctly, but I can't get treatment reminders to work how I expected.

Food treatment is fine. I get a reminder to eat (let's say I inject at 6pm for an aim to eat at 6.20pm, xDrip will alert me at 6.20 to eat)

If I'm splitting my dose, say half at 6pm and half at 7pm, I get no reminder to inject.

Is this intentional, am I doing something wrong, or is it a bug?

Thanks

Edit for clarity: I enter the treatment screen on xDrip, add my injection and save it. Re-enter the treatment screen, add my food with a time and get a notification at that time reminding me to eat.

If I enter the treatment screen and add insulin immediately, then re-enter, add more insulin and set the time for later I get no reminder

comments.body:
Hi folks, I have noticed some irregular behaviour on treatment reminders too. On my phone (pixel 3a with Android 10) xdrip downloads treatments via the NSClient api. in the case of a pre-bolus record at mealtime (insulin followed by carbs 15 mins later)  I receive a reminder to eat but not at the appointed time. I only receive the reminder when I next unlock my phone and open xdrip - sometimes many minutes later. I receive all the other reminders and alerts from xdrip just fine with the phone locked and xdrip in the background...

Any tips or ideas from others appreciated!

Many thanks to the developers for all your awesome work on this.

You will get a lot of advice if you post on the xDrip facebook group.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
Or, the the xDrip room on Gitter.  https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
